name: Monorail for GNOME (beta)
description: Scrolling tiling, beta. New windows open side by side in a strip of columns at full height, and the strip scrolls to keep the focused window on screen. Each workspace has its own strip. Super+Alt+Left/Right moves focus, Super+Alt+Shift+Left/Right moves a column, Super+Alt+W cycles its width and Super+Alt+F makes it full width. Dialogs and other small windows are left floating.
